reviews.text:
Heartless.

They treated my dogs for an ear infection and then on the recheck appointment they canceled our appointment because I was at work and couldn't pay their multiple day in advance prepay instantly. Even though I told them I just needed to get home from work to be able to pay it.

I immediately called them and asked them to please not drop our appointment, and I was told that if I can't pay the prepaid immediately on the phone right there I couldn't bring my dogs back for their recheck. I was still not home!!!! I told them that, but they didn't care.

Most vets do their recheck without even charging, these ones throw you out in the cold and don't care if your pets are okay over a minuscule 130 charge half a week in advance. No communication and no mercy. Awful
Good experience. Clear prices. Good bed side manner.

The office was well kept and all staff were welcoming and informative.  I love that I found them and they are right here in PB~!  Thank you for a great first experience~! All of the staff I encountered on Saturday were welcoming and professional.  Overall vibe in the office was top notch!
Everyone is wonderful and caring. Thank you to all the staff: front desk, vet techs and Dr. Noppinger. Care and kindness
Carla rules. That’s it. That’s the review.

I really wanted to like this veterinary hospital since they are close to me and reasonably priced. I'm a pretty new client. After two visits and a few "human mistakes" I'm just done. They are nice and friendly, but I'd rather have competent and polite.
Took our pup for his first vet appointment and it went great. The staff were very friendly and sweet and the office was nice and clean.

I’ve had no issues with routine checkups or vaccines, however for an emergency visit my experience was under par. There was poor diagnosis education. Never was told what could of caused my dog’s condition, what to look out for, etc... I felt extremely rushed. On leaving, no follow up appointment was made for my dog.

TL;DR: Overpriced and ineffective treatment, Bayview Vet is a much better option.

Since leaving this vet and finding a practice that is run pets first, not money first, I wanted to leave a review to express my dissatisfaction with ABC Vet.

Firstly- the people working here are very kind, and this is not a reflection upon them, rather the way the business is run and the costs of services (hence leaving 2 stars and not one).

To book a visit, ask a question, or do anything here, you need to make an appointment- which costs $85 up front, at time of booking, not upon delivery of service.

At each appointment I had, I was oversold testing, medications, and treatments, which yielded little results or health improvement for my cat, and hundreds of dollars spent.

Additionally, they send a plethora of sales emails (every 2-3 days?), promoting products and services with no relevance to my pet, and on multiple occasions I had to cancel orders for products I had not placed an order for. If this were a retail operation, I would understand, but for a doctors office to send sales emails with such frequency is just off putting. (Imagine if your doctor send you 3 emails a week trying to sell you products & medications you didn't need).

All of this to say, they were not able to resolve my cats health issues and I had no choice but to find another doctor.

I have since moved to Bayview Veterinary Center (very close by in PB), and the experience is night and day. This is a place where I can call and ask questions (for free), speak to the doctor (for free), have a thoughtful and cost aware treatment plan, and get reimbursed for products or medications that have not worked for my pet. I wish I switched years ago, which would have saved me hundreds and hundreds of dollars, loads of emotional and financial stress, and most likely resulted in faster recovery for my sweet boy.

I never have an issue making an appointment, even in emergencies. I appreciate the attention to my pup when I arrive. I appreciate the thoroughness of the of his examinations and follow-up texts and calls. Charla is consistently friendly on every visit, and her energy is much appreciated. All of the front desk associates have been lovely.

All of the staff is always super friendly and helpful whenever we have an appointment. It always feels like we're getting all the support and recommendations needed. A special shoutout to the front desk staff. No matter who is working they always treat Stevie in such a special and caring manner making vet visits much easier!
Very friendly , reliable and quick response.
Thanks for the 5 stars! It means everything to know you're happy with our care! 😊 …

The entire staff was welcoming, helpful, and had empathy & compassion, providing
guidance with my senior dog
Dr Noppinger is the best vet and I can’t thank her enough for everything she’s done to support my babies. I’ve been going to ABC vet since i adopted my dogs 5 years ago
Thanks so much for the review!

We’ve been taking our dog Dixie to ABC Vet for about a year now, and every experience has been amazing. Everyone there, from the front desk staff to the vet techs and doctors is incredibly kind, knowledgeable, and caring.

Dixie is a rescue with a traumatic background, so she can be very timid and anxious, but the entire team has always been so patient and kind to her. It’s clear they genuinely care about animals and go out of their way to make both pets and owners feel comfortable.

We’re so grateful to have found a vet we fully trust. Highly, highly recommend.
Dipper had a great visit and was purring the entire time.
Amazing staff. Won’t go anywhere else

I have been a client at ABC Veterinary Hospital in Pacific Beach for more than 20 years. Over that time I have had 4 dogs and 8 cats. One of our dogs was the famous Sunset Cliffs rescue dog (she had to be rescued from the bottom of the cliffs by the lifeguards) and the folks at ABC recognized her and knew that we were coming in based on the news story. They have been wonderful and I would recommend them to anyone who asked.

I am so glad I decided to come see the team at ABC Vet! Maxie (my ACD) and I have had to move around a bit the last few years and have had care from various facilities around San Diego that we weren't thrilled with. I asked a zillion people who they use and so many recommendations came back for ABC from people I really trust. I didn't feel like they rushed me out, they were interested in Maxie's backstory, temperament, and were so sweet to her (she's a bit shy). I felt like she was being well looked after and I was kept well informed of what was happening, when, and why. They also didn't try to upsell me on a bunch of services that we didn't need, which I really appreciate. I know everything is a business, but pet owners want to feel like their pet it actually being care for, not just sold products. Literally everyone was so awesome! The front desk was super nice (and there was a queue that formed and delivery people, and ramps needed, and phone calls, and a dog owner who didn't seem to have the concept that he was in a public space....?) and she handled everything really well. The vet techs were super communicative and patient with my girl and Dr Sayers was so kind and helpful. Overall kind, communicative staff, who made me feel heard and like I was getting excellent care for my pet.
Thanks for the 5 stars, Anastasiya! It means everything to know you're happy with our care! 😊 …
Thanks so much for the review, Tara!

Super happy with my experiences here. I have a really reactive GSD that isn’t great with people or dogs and they’re very accommodating despite it all! Special shoutout to Dr. Noppinger who stayed in the room with us for a while chatting/asking questions at our first appointment. After she was done examining my dog he relaxed enough to flop over while she was in the room!

ABC vet is amazing! All of the staff are extremely happy and kind. The office is always clean and welcoming. My cat Goose has seen Dr. Sayers three times now and she remembered him and all of his previous visits which means so much. Could not recommend them more!

We have three rescue bully breeds, but unfortunately, we had to say goodbye to one of our babies a month ago.
For the last four years, we were at the vet almost every month. We felt manipulated and ripped off by different clinics for years. They were never able to identify our dogs' primary health issues; instead, they made assumptions and prescribed endless medications. Only God knows what truly happens behind those closed doors.
Everything changed when we met Dr. Nicole Svehla.
• Rosa (Bull Terrier): Rosa used to refuse to walk or engage in any activity. Dr. Svehla discovered that Rosa had a deep ear canal infection that she had been suffering from for years. She also diagnosed her with Cushing’s disease. After Dr. Svehla cleaned her ears and started her on the correct medication, Rosa became a brand-new dog. She loves to play and interact now.
• Yuki: We rescued Yuki from a shelter six months ago when she was on a "48-hour kill list." She had many health issues, but Dr. Svehla healed her. The team at ABC Vet showed her so much love and care that her first impression of a veterinarian was positive; now, she isn't afraid to go to the clinic.
• Sakura: Sakura came into our lives when she was only five weeks old. She wasn't just a dog; she was a human in a dog’s body. She was incredibly emotional and loved interacting with people and children. Tragically, she suffered at the hands of the wrong veterinarians for three years.
When we finally met Dr. Nicole, she immediately referred us to a neurologist. Thanks to that specialist, we finally discovered that Sakura had Storage Disease, which has no cure. Sakura had been suffering from this for years while previous veterinarians simply pumped her body full of medicine based on assumptions. I will never forgive them for that.
Dr. Nicole and the ABC Vet team were by our side during Sakura’s final months, supporting us in every way possible. Dr. Nicole provided a gentle "goodbye" for our baby at home. Afterward, the team sent us a beautiful letter and created a lovely box for Sakura’s ashes. We keep their letter right next to her.
We are so thankful for their kindness and generosity. We feel blessed to have Dr. Nicole as our veterinarian and the ABC Pacific Beach Vet team to support us during our most difficult time.
Many veterinarians fail to understand that dogs are part of our family—they are our children, our companions, and our soulmates. They deserve to be treated with the same care as a child. After such a hurtful experience elsewhere, Dr. Nicole Svehla and the ABC Vet team are the only people I trust with my dogs. I will never take them anywhere else.

Due to their appointment policy I with suggest finding another veterinary hospital. They require you to pay in advance for the appointment. Which should hold your appointment. They sent a text before 7 am to confirm appointment, when my appointment was at 10. Then since no reply, at 8 they sent a text, the appointment was cancelled. I called, they stated they attempted to call and my appointment was no longer available. This not good practice, especially since many individuals, such as myself, work alternative schedules  It is a shame because I have 3 animals, one with significant health problems, which would of been financially advantageous for them. I found an alternative veterinarian office That is much more accommodating, which I suggest you do the same.

I didn't feel the vet had enough experience to help me make decisions.  I got a second opinion at a more experienced vet, who solved the problem with minimal distress to the animal and much lower cost to me.  The office staff is not very efficient or organized - they are friendly but don't follow through, and don't tell us why the appointments are never on time or how long we'll be waiting (which happens literally every time I go in there).
Thank you for the 5 stars!
Thank you for the 5 stars!

Tremendous care shown for my cat. Dr Sayres got down on his level to evaluate him, took care not to rush, gentle, and was sure of what she was doing. Quiet competence is very reassuring. Put him in a quiet room as soon as we came in. Fernanda helped me get him into the pet carrier when we were leaving! I've never had that level of assistance and I really welcomed it. Fernanda was also very understanding and helpful when presenting the treatment options. And she gave Shredder a treat :)

I pretty much live my vet. They have done a great job helping me manage my animals over the years. My little old dog just had some surgery and she is doing really well! I would absolutely recommend these guys to anyone looking for a vet. The doctors are great, the front counter staff are lovely, and everyone always makes my visits go well.

ABC vet is the best! Dr. Sayres was wonderful- she was thorough, gentle, and had so much knowledge and recommendations for my pup. The vet techs were also gentle and kind and it was clear they were extremely knowledgable when drawing my dog's blood through her neck. The front desk people are always friendly and helpful.
My pup is really scared of the vet. Dr. Noppinger and her amazing staff were patient and made him feel comfortable—he warmed up to them quickly! Clean, aesthetically pleasing office too.

I’m so happy with Dr. Nottinger and all the staff at ABC Vet. They are knowledgeable, professional, and very warm. They have given my dog the best of care, emailed me articles for more info, and quickly made a referral to the specialty hospital for major surgery. I plan to take my dog to ABC for a long time.
Everyone here is friendly, helpful and knowledgeable. We've been able to get appointments in a decent timeframe. The costs are very reasonable and they offer a military discount!
Excellent and reasonable . Thanks
Thank you for your 5 stars Liz! We are so happy to you have you and Gemma in our ABC family. We always look forward to her visits!

If you have a furry member of the family, THIS IS YOUR VET. For my first visit, my appointment was at 3pm. The check in process was one simple sheet and took LESS THAN 5 minutes. My cat (Maui) was checked by the nurse at 3:05 and the doctor was in the exam room by 3:10. The exam was thorough and complete. Maui was taken back for a full panel blood work and was prescribed antibiotics for a mouth infection in 15 minutes. Maui and I were out the door with his prescriptions IN HAND at 3:40. The exam rooms are very clean, the treats are plentiful, and most importantly the staff is caring, thorough and time efficient. Save yourself the frustration and long waits many other vets make you deal with and just come here.
Very friendly & professional! 💕🐾

I had a wonderful experience at ABC Veterinary Hospital! The staff was amazing. Friendly, kind, attentive and truly compassionate. From the moment my dog Finn and I arrived, everyone went out of their way to make us feel welcome and comfortable. During the exam, Dr. Noppinger explained everything clearly and provided exceptional care. I am so grateful that I finally found a clinic that provides trustworthy and professional care. Thank you so much, Dana Bungé

Incredible experience coming here with my dog. They were so prompt and had the same sense of urgency as I did to help get my dogs documents in order before travelling internationally - even though I was a first time visitor to the hospital. I’m so pleased and would immediately come here any time I’m in San Diego and need to visit a Vet.

Our dog stopped eating and we were able to get a next day appt.  Dr Sayres was very kind and informative, they got x-rays quickly day of so we could better understand the situation, which was serious.
Overall, I was impressed at their responsiveness (despite the busyness of a vet clinic), communication, and prioritization of our situation. They made every attempt to get back to us quickly and were very personable.
Sadly our dog passed in a short time, but to have the prompt knowledge that it truly might be his last days allowed us to process and accept the best we could. Thank you everyone 🙏
The staff and Veterinarian were great and they gave me plenty of options for care, not pushing excessive or expensive treatment. Thank you!

The doctor and assistants are kind, caring and knowledgeable. They are very flexible also and will fit you into their schedule when needed. We’ve been trusting them with our cats and dogs for over 16 years!
The staff is efficient and obviously loves the dogs.

We have taken out Sofie to ABC Vets for almost 15 years. We have taken our dogs before her We love the attention all you staff give to our Rozee. And gave to our Sofie in earlier years. You listen to us and describe things in a way we can understand. Charla is always great, there with a smile. The love and kindness with which you treat the animals. also. Everyone is kind and professional, always simpathetic to our pets' troubles, and tries to find the best way to help them. They are all so gentle with the pets. You can tell they love animals.

Dr. Z is fantastic!! my boys love getting acupuncture at ABC Veterinary. Their staff is really sweet and nice with my frosted faces babies starting with Charla who showers them with treats and going thru all their team at the desks and their techs who warm up the injections before administering them and hold them with so much care. 5 stars and 2 thumbs up.
They were wonderful

Good veterinary clinic.
We regularly come here to purchase Simparica Trio tablets. Everything is quick, convenient, and hassle-free

I am so happy with the entire staff of this clinic. From checking in and seeing all the smiles from the front desk receptionist to the care my furbaby received from all the staff. I’m so thankful for everyone’s calm supportive attitudes especially when I was so concerned for my sick pup. Queso loves going to visit with everyone!

As always, friendly and caring service! Everyone from front desk to tech to Vet were all a pleasure to deal with!
I have been using this office for literally decades. It has become decidedly even much better since new owners took over. I drive from Chula Vista to take my pets here. I really appreciate the no pressure approach to care for my pets. I like to know my options and order of importance and then decide what my budget can afford while still keeping my pets doing well. Thank you!!!
ABC vet is the best - I am so grateful for the team and all of their care. Thank you so much:)
We are grateful for your wonderful review, Rachel!

I have been looking for a new vet for sometime. Our vet of 15 years retired. I was looking for good bed side manner, reasonable pricing, ability to be able to get in without having to wait weeks. ABC Vets in PB met all those critieria. I have dogs and cats. My first visit was with a stray mama cat that I decided to take in. I needed to get her in for a checkup and vaccines. I called and they scheduled me that same week. The staff and vet were all super nice. The vet advised me on how to help mama take care of her kittens. On our 2nd vaccine follow up, I was in and out in 15 minutes. They didn't charge me to see the vet just for the shots. I love that. With everything so exspensive, I appreciate that.
The staff is wonderful and so kind to my doggy.

BEST CLINIC IN SAN DIEGO.

ABC in Pb has been so great to our family. With an aging cat and dog we have had to deal with a lot of issues. Dr. Z and her team truly care and take the time to guide us and make sure we are comfortable through every step. Dealing with a terminally ill pet has been devastating, but our beloved practice gave our fur baby comfort and vitality during the last season of his life. We could not have gone through this phase without ABC.

Our dog receives acupuncture (one of the only spots in town for this), and she has responded beautifully. We even started up agility classes with her again! Her treatment plan and blend of eastern medicine has worked wonders.

I can’t say enough great things about this place. It’s clean, the staff are great, and the doctors are top notch. I highly recommend this clinic to anyone looking for an amazing local, NON-Corporate, family-owned vet practice.

Seems very strange! ABC veteran lists don’t worry we Do all international health certificates !  But told me Not Vietnam the  easy south east Asia to do !  I Don’t understand! Here is proof then told me they done to many this month! When airlines are losing billions of dollars ! Has not been this slow since the pandemic! To Get international health certificate ! I am sure I got discriminated against! Money motivated! Place ! Since I Had her microchip and most shots! Was not profitable !

This vet office will find any reason they can to take every last dollar they can get from you.  I took one of my dogs in to have her stool tested due to an ongoing bowel issue. Before the tests were even done they wanted to put her on probiotics and prescription food. A few days later the tests showed nothing wrong and the issue cleared up on its own. They will require expensive testing for you to obtain prescriptions and make you pay every time you walk through the door, even when you are returning because an issue that was previously treated has still not been resolved. My dog was being treated for a skin infection that he was on antibiotics for for over two weeks. When the infection hadn't cleared after that time I had to pay to bring him back just for them to give him another two weeks of the same antibiotics. They wanted him to come back two weeks after that for another checkup and pay again. Many other vet offices on the area will not charge for follow up appointments when the issue is ongoing. I recommend finding one of them before going here.

The care is so intentional and helpful. They remember my dog and treat her like a long lost friend and she loves them for it. Everyone is so kind and you can tell the animals truly trust them. Everyone is amazing! From the person who answers the phone to the person behind the desk when we come in to the vet, everyone is so kind and welcoming. I also appreciate that they don't try to sell me on anything, and tell me exactly what I need to know about my dog's health and how to best care for her. I trust them with her entirely.
ABC vet has some of the friendliest, knowledgeable staff. Everyone, from the front desk to technicians to doctors always go above and beyond. I am so comfortable trusting them with my kitties care.

Had a great first experience at ABC vet! Was able to easily book an appointment to get my puppy in the next day. The staff were so friendly - especially Bailey at the front desk! She was so warm and made my puppy feel comfortable. Wait times were short and they gave us a new member discount which was nice
Tries to charge for unnecessary vaccines, skips over critical disease information, does not seem to care about well being of pets.

So 2 stars because usually this place is super helpful and nice. But I’ve been met with attitude and rudeness from one person in particular at the front desk. I’ve called in the past to make an appointment and was also met with the same problem, and today I had my boyfriend call to make an appointment for our cat and this lady again was super rude. He took his dog here for years and most of them are super nice and helpful but one of them is just blatantly rude and unhelpful. We just wanted to make an appointment and get some information because that’s literally their job as front desk at a vets office. They’re are losing business and customers having that woman work in that office. Again just this one lady, everyone else has been super nice, so be aware when trying to schedule an appointment over the phone. She was working at 3pm on 10/14/25.

Amazing care, everyone was so sweet and professional, I will def recommend to everyone!! I honestly had the best care with EVERYONE but I do have to mention Charla that helped me out in the front desk, she was so sweet and helped me through a situation that I was having someplace else! Everyone was so sweet and patient, I loved Alyssa who helped me with all my questions and Dr Robin was SO SWEET with my dog, Marley loved her right away! Very caring and sweet!

Been using ABC for all my dogs for a very long time. I’ve been slowly recognizing the flaws in their business as they continue to get worse with each passing year. Today was the last straw and I will be looking for a new vet.
Overall reason: unprofessional, poor communication.. I mean really poor, condescending when you question anything and everything they do or recommend, take forever to follow through on things like medications and refill, seem very money motivated at every visit/check up, had been working with their Vet for years on complicated meds and the vet left the practice without any word from ABC, there are more reasons but this should be enough to give you the idea of what kind of “care” they provide.
In closing I told them I was gonna look for a new vet today and they don’t care at all. Asked them to email my dogs chart so I can start new service elsewhere. They said, sure we will send it over. Of course, they did not email me anything. This accurately summarizes their service in general.

Dr. Zaranak was so caring and answered all questions related to our concerns about our pet. Dr. Zaranak took her time and made us feel comfortable which made a big difference when choosing options for diagnostics and treatment . ABC veterinary clinic in Pacific Beach is awesome!
They were very helpful in obtaining the paperwork necessary to take our dog to Europe and they were very good with our dog.
The best, caring and very good

Amazing vet! The staff is so nice and welcoming! Dr. Noppinger is so knowledgeable, kind, and most importantly, a staunch advocate for my dogs. I've gone to several other clinics and seen several other doctors, and she has been the best.

Dr. Svehla was fantastic.  My experience at the clinic was exceptional.  The front desk staff was pleasant, uplifting, and personable. The whole environment with other patients was fantastic as well.  Clients were comfortable being there, even with whatever was going on with their pets.  Very positive experience.  Thanks to everyone.
Thank you for the 5 stars!

Dr. Svehla, Fernanda and Charla were amazing. My husband sometimes has balance issues and he lost his balance when walking down the front stairs to get a urine specimen from Sienna. Fernanda saved my husband from falling. Charla stepped up to help Fernanda get the specimen while my husband sat down. We are forever grateful. Dr. Svehla, Fernanda and Charla were excellent, caring and went above and beyond to help Sienna and my husband.

This place is wonderful. The staff is extremely professional very knowledgeable. The only drawback is you’re gonna have to put out a premium price at this place but I think it would be worth it. I personally cannot afford right now, but if I did have the money, I would certainly use this place.

We started bringing our dog, Joaquin, to ABC for acupuncture after his back surgery and continued with ABC as our primary vet due to the kindness and professionalism of the staff and doctors. On certain appointments, the doctors had more information and insights about various ailments than our previous vet was not knowledgeable about and ignored.
We are always given many treatment options and prices before moving forward and our opinions are taken into account. We recommend ABC Vet! They also have fundraisers, adoption events and give back to local shelters throughout the year.

Every member of the staff was amazing. They took care of us and always made sure we were comfortable and if we needed anything. Dr. Zaranek was extremely knowledgeable and helped me to understand som concerns with chew toys and other things

ABC's staff, veterinarians, techs and front desk, are always exceptional. For the past 7 years we've been bringing a (shared) dog and my cat to their practice. The veterinarians are always so caring to both humans and our pets, and have the best, up-to-date care.

Both of our pets have had their routine dentals here, and I was pleasantly surprised they do an EKG on older (8+) kitties prior to anesthesia, which is a fantastic health check! I'd almost taken my cat to Banfield for her dental, but didn't have the same quality experience yet the prices at ABC were similar and reasonable, with much better services to the pets.

We also brought a pregnant dog in, before and after she had puppies. The vet/owner was incredible in coaching us through that crazy experience, and reassured us we were doing everything right.

Here's my kitty, high as a kite, after her dental ...she always seems relaxed at ABC clinic, with or without the happy-kitty-drugs!

This is not for care. The van drivers are aweful! Very bad drivers unfortunately! I would not recommend! I also called to let them know. They didnt care! If they don't care about that why would they care about my pet!

I was looking for a Vet closer to my home and found ABC Veterinary Hospital.  My six year old cat had an appointment to get acquainted and later a procedure that required her to stay at the clinic for the day.  The entire staff is lovely, caring and thoughtful.   I felt that my cat had excellent care and was contacted a few days later to be sure that she was doing fine at home.
It was our first time there. The staff was friendly and helpful.

This office is awesome! They were able to take my cat in quickly for a dental procedure even though she was not an established patient. Dr. Sevhla and all of the staff were very helpful and efficient, doctor called me with a detailed explanation of what my kitty needed before beginning. Everything went smoothly and my cat was sent home with her medication in pre-filled syringes! This was a great help for me. I highly recommend ABC Vets!

Very clean, family feeling. They care about all aspects of the pet involved.
Most knowledgeable and informative as what is going on and what to do in the future. Very helpful.
The personel is very kind. Communication with the clinic is great.

Extremely disappointed with ABC PB.. Been taking my dogs here... always noticed they're money motivated, but neither of my dogs had issues for me to want to find another vet. My cheapest appointment was just shy of $600 and that's just coming in for vaccines and check up. They will find a way to get as much money out of you as possible.
My minpin started to get skin and eye issues... ABC is doing nothing but running the same tests we've already tested. They put him on a bacteria controlling eyedrop and eye lubrication for dry eye. I've came many times to pick up the eye medicine when I run out.. last time I came they wouldn't sell it to me. Said I need to come in for a full appointment and run tests again. If he's been deemed negative or positive for a test multiple times why keep running it when the issue obviously isn't going away. They were in there about a month and a half ago so it hasn't been over a year. Ran these tests 4+ times wasting money.. I've spent over $8000+ in the past year there. And the only issue my dogs have is one has dry eye.
I spoke to Alyssa, the vet manager.. She was extremely unprofessional, condescending, and rude. Doesn't know what she's talking about.. kept changing the reason why they won't sell me the eyedrops and why I need to come in and spend another $1000 on tests. She laughed when I told her my dog can't see and is bumping into things. I have proof of an ophthalmologist and dermatologist specialist appointment coming up. After arguing w/ Alyssa I explained I'm not coming here again and I'm leaving a review... after that she said "hold on I can the eyedrop filled for you."
I ended up leaving and going to a different vet who ensured they will keep me in supply of these eyedrop's till the specialist has this eye issue in control without running the tests.
The eye gunk is before the eye drops the other picture is one day after.. ABC has financially robbed me... Failed my dog and Alyssa has awful business management skills.

I've had many other bad experiences and have witnessed many bad experiences at this Vet... I am glad that I am now out and gone.
Nicole... please don't respond to this review as you guys have utterly failed my dogs and I... Since day one you guys have showed me nothing but money hungry, uneducated, unsympathetic care.. I already spent an hour arguing with rude Alyssa and don't want to go back-and-forth with you guys anymore. She had every chance to not make me draw the line with you guys.
Able to communicate well and answer all my questions.  Great vet!
Thank you for your review!
Very calm and professional doctors and assistants. They handled our cat with care and gave good treatment.

I recently visited ABC Veterinary Office to obtain a health certificate for my pet, and I couldn’t be more impressed with the level of care and dedication the manager who assisted me Alyssa showed throughout the entire process. From the moment I walked in, the staff went above and beyond to make sure everything was handled smoothly and efficiently.

Alyssa not only accommodated my tight timeline, but also guided me through the paperwork and requirements with patience and clarity. It’s clear that they truly care about both their patients.

I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend them to anyone looking for a veterinary team that genuinely puts their heart into their work. Thank you again for going the extra mile!
Dr N the best!
Everyone is always so friendly and welcoming. They all truly love animals and care about what's best for our pet. everyone's kindness

We had an incredible experience at the vet! Dr. Sayres has such a thoughtful and informative approach—truly impressive. The doctor who saw us (I believe it was Dr. Sayres and Riva) was warm, professional, and made us feel completely at ease. The entire staff was friendly, attentive, and clearly cared about our visit. Grateful for such a compassionate and knowledgeable team!
Used them for international pet travel. Haven't actually traveled yet but they seem super on top of it and have been very organized and responsive. Will update after travel if we have any issues.

The receptionists have always been very kind, but the doctors here are awful. I'm usually not one to leave bad reviews, but this place is not a vet, it's a money grab/scammy place. The emails/text messages with "sales" are alarming. Every time I've gone in they're always trying to "upsell." My dog got bit by another dog so I brought him in, hoping they would be compassionate. A $75 exam fee for an "exam" that took 2 minutes and $75 to clean his wound? Absolutely unheard of. Do not choose this place as your place of care for your fur babies unless you're a fan of a vet that is operated like a cash grab. On top of this, their only solution to anything is to put your pets on antibiotics/pills. There's no holistic approach to pet care. Absolutely TERRIBLE!!!

ABC Vets saved my dog Levi's life last summer. Levi was run over by a motorcycle at Fiesta Island and had severe road rash and infection. ABC vet was able to get me into the vet the next day and took amazing care of him. Throughout the painful healing process they cared for him like he was their own, and answered my numerous calls throughout the healing journey. They used a homeopathic treatment of honey to heal his road rash almost completely, I was sceptical about going the natural route but the results were amazing. After about 6 weeks of aftercare and bandage changes I decided to take over the care of his wounds and although he healed, you can see the difference is scar tissue between the honey treatment ( no scar and his hair grew back) and when I took over with antibiotic ointment ( has a scar and hair still hasn't grown back). although they are a bit pricey in my opinion if you're like me and want the best for your pet its worth the extra money for exceptional care.
